name: Steviol glycosides from Stevia
aliases: E960a, E960c, E960d, steviol glycosides, stevioside, rebaudioside A, glucósidos de esteviol, stevia, stevia extract, steviol glycoside, E960 sweetener
what_is: A purified mixture of high-intensity sweet compounds, including stevioside and rebaudiosides, extracted from Stevia rebaudiana leaves.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E960 because 'stevia' sounds like the leaf, but the label usually means purified steviol glycosides. WHO's 2023 recommendation on non-sugar sweeteners explicitly includes stevia and its derivatives.
can_1: Detect E960a, E960c, E960d and Stevia-derived synonyms on food labels.
can_2: Identify the specific steviol glycoside subclass when declared.
cannot_1: Verify whether unapproved extraction solvents were used during manufacturing.
cannot_2: Determine the exact ratio of stevioside to rebaudioside A.
title: Steviol glycosides from Stevia
description: High-intensity sweet compounds extracted from the leaves of Stevia rebaudiana.
